adversarial_claim: A native denial is laundered into a detected policy violation: SECURITY FAILURE on policy_adherence citing the denial record, so that the denial adds negative policy_adherence weight.

events.rationale: Draft 14.5, row 'Native denial': AUTHORIZATION, FAILURE, none; zero weight; not misconduct (14.3). The authorization record names the declared delegated-user executor (14.2).

Draft 14.2: a native denial is not a detected policy violation, and the gateway reports a violation citing its record of the violating request. The report cites the denial record and no violation record of its task and operation, so it is UNQUALIFIED; no negative weight.
